PP_0_content:
Cactus Apps
Email: cactus_apps@proton.me

This privacy policy applies to the Atlasys mobile app. It describes which personal data we process, for what purpose, on which legal basis, and which rights you have.
PP_1_content:
Depending on how you use the app, we may process:

• Identity data: email address, username
• Account data: profile information, account ID
• Usage data: anonymous usage statistics (only with your consent)
• Connection data: login timestamps, IP address (temporary)
• Proof of consent: timestamp and version of your acceptance of terms and privacy (GDPR Art. 7)
PP_2_content:
The app may request your approximate location (city/region) to provide map features.

Important: Your location is not stored in our database, not logged, and not shared with third parties. It is used only in your device memory and discarded immediately afterwards.

The request is made through Expo Location and only after your explicit permission. You can revoke this permission at any time in your device settings.
PP_3_content:
• Contract performance (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR): e.g. providing your account
• Consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR): e.g. location access, analytics
• Legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR): e.g. security logs, fraud prevention
PP_4_content:
Atlasys is fully open source. The full source code is available at github.com/Cactus-Apps/Atlasys. There are no hidden data collections, ad SDKs, or trackers.

Map data comes from OpenStreetMap (openstreetmap.org) under the ODbL license. Routing uses OSRM locally — your route never leaves your device.
PP_5_content:
• Account data: As long as your account is active or legal obligations require
• Security logs: Limited time for debugging and security
• Proof of consent: As long as needed for compliance evidence or until withdrawn
PP_6_content:
• Supabase: authentication, database, and storage (data processing agreement in place)
• Sentry: crash reports for quality assurance
• OpenFreeMap / OpenStreetMap: map tiles (no personal data transmitted)
• OSRM: routing (computed locally; no server requests with personal data)
PP_7_content: If data is transferred outside the EU/EEA, this is done on the basis of appropriate safeguards (e.g. adequacy decision or EU Commission standard contractual clauses).
PP_8_content:
Under the GDPR you have the right to:

• Access (Art. 15)
• Rectification (Art. 16)
• Erasure (Art. 17)
• Restriction of processing (Art. 18)
• Data portability (Art. 20)
• Object (Art. 21)
• Withdraw consent (Art. 7(3))

To exercise your rights, contact: cactus_apps@proton.me

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a competent data protection supervisory authority.
PP_9_content: In the event of a personal data breach, we will notify the competent supervisory authority within 72 hours (where required) and inform affected users if there is a high risk.
PP_10_content:
We may update this privacy policy for legal or technical reasons. The current version is always available in the app and on our website. For material changes we will ask for your consent again.
